attributes.action: Ban on sale of disposable BBQs
attributes.additional_details:
With increasing pressure on waste management systems and growing climate-related fire risk, we believe action is needed to reduce avoidable harm caused by these products. We are therefore asking the Government to:
 
1. Introduce a UK-wide ban on the sale of disposable BBQs
2. Encourage safer, reusable alternatives through public guidance
3. Work with retailers to support the transition away from single-use outdoor cooking products
attributes.background: We want the Government to introduce a nationwide ban on the sale of single-use disposable barbecues. Disposable BBQs are increasingly linked to preventable wildfires, which  poses a serious risk to public safety, wildlife, and emergency services. Also, disposable BBQs contribute to unnecessary waste
